# Java resource audit

Exact plan, argv, log/process hashes, workload/sample counts and identical probe source/class bytes passed audit. All cold and warm observations remain in the JSON and unchanged raw logs.

Pair order is baseline/candidate sequences 0/1, 3/2, 5/4 and 6/7. Each ratio uses within-JVM warm medians before pairing. Core emits one warm sample per JVM, so its within-JVM median is that single sample.

Core metrics are **elapsed time**, not thread CPU. Index and bitmap primary metrics are **current-thread CPU**. Linux wait4 observations remain separately labelled whole-process statistics.

The frozen plan calls for focused confirmation of a consistent CPU regression above 10%. The tables report every count of paired ratios >1.10; two or more such pairs are marked as repeated observations for review, not as a newly invented acceptance rule. No resource-admission decision is automated here.
